intro.h2: Kitchen backsplash tile installation for patterns that take patience
paragraphs: Solid Setting Tile and Stone Inc. is a tile contractor for kitchen backsplash tile in Wesley Chapel, FL, and its Google photos show mostly backsplash work: cobalt herringbone running the length of a kitchen wall, black and white marble set in a diamond pattern, and glossy gray herringbone behind a gas cooktop.

Reviewers keep naming Melissa, who works alongside her son. One couple says she installed their backsplash very carefully and without rushing, and that the price was very reasonable despite a complicated tile pattern. Another client says the new backsplash gives their kitchen a great pop of color, and praises the precision and attention to detail.

items.name: Kitchen backsplash installation
items.blurb: From plain white subway tile above a gas range to a full wall of tile behind a chimney hood, backsplashes make up most of the work this team shows on Google. One client calls hers beautiful and praises the company's professionalism and dependability.

items.name: Herringbone and patterned layouts
items.blurb: Patterns take more cutting and more patience. The crew has set herringbone in glazed gray and deep blue, plus a black and white marble mosaic in a diamond pattern under a stainless hood. One couple notes the price stayed very reasonable despite their complicated pattern.

items.name: Wet bar and coffee bar backsplashes
items.blurb: Tile does not have to stop at the kitchen. This wet bar got a blue herringbone backsplash that climbs between glass-front cabinets and behind open shelves, with under-cabinet light washing across the glaze. Bring photos of your bar or nook when you call.

service_area.h2: Kitchen backsplash tile in Wesley Chapel, FL
service_area.text: Solid Setting Tile and Stone Inc. serves homeowners in Wesley Chapel, FL, and the crew comes to your home to set the tile. If you live outside Wesley Chapel, call (813) 701-6923 or email solidsettingtile@gmail.com with your town and a photo of the wall or floor you want tiled, and ask whether you are in their area. Office hours are Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 4 PM and Friday 7 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: Can you install a complicated tile pattern?
items.a: Yes. Herringbone and patterned layouts appear across their Google photos, including a black and white marble diamond mosaic. One couple chose a complicated tile pattern for their kitchen backsplash and says the work was done very carefully, without rushing, and the price was still very reasonable.

Kitchen backsplashes are the work shown most often, but the photos also include a wet bar with blue herringbone tile, and two Google reviews mention master bath remodels. Call (813) 701-6923 to describe your room and the tile you have in mind.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Reviews name Melissa as the installer, and one client describes working with Melissa and her son as a wonderful experience. Another homeowner praises the company's professionalism and dependability and highly recommends them for similar projects. Several reviewers also describe the staff as knowledgeable.

Solid Setting Tile and Stone Inc. is open Monday through Thursday from 8 AM to 4 PM and Friday from 7 AM to 5 PM. They are closed on weekends. Call (813) 701-6923, or email solidsettingtile@gmail.com with photos of your project at any time.

items.q: How do I get a price for a backsplash?
items.a: Call or email to request an estimate. The price depends on the size of the wall, the tile you choose and the layout, since herringbone and mosaics take more cuts than straight subway tile. Photos and rough measurements make that first conversation quicker.

final_cta.h2: Have a bare wall that needs a backsplash?
final_cta.text: Call Melissa's team Monday to Friday and talk through the tile and pattern you want.
